WITH matched AS (
  SELECT sc.zoneref, s.insurstat
  FROM scanconservation AS sc
  INNER JOIN sites AS s
    ON sc.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
), grouped AS (
  SELECT zoneref, insurstat, COUNT(*) AS record_count
  FROM matched
  GROUP BY zoneref, insurstat
)
SELECT zoneref AS site_reference,
       insurstat AS insurance_status,
       record_count,
       record_count::numeric / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM matched), 0) AS share_of_matched_records
FROM grouped
ORDER BY share_of_matched_records DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;
